evidence.title: These claims about the new coronavirus and 5G are unfounded ...
evidence.snippet_en: Full Fact rated the claim "5G is harmful to humans" with "There is no evidence that 5G can harm people.", indicating that there is no evidence to support the claim that 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus.
evidence.rating_text: There is no evidence that 5G can harm people.

evidence.title: A retracted paper linking 5G and coronavirus with no evidence is ...
evidence.snippet_en: Full Fact rated the claim "5G millimeter waves could be absorbed by skin cells acting as antennas, transferred to other cells and play the main role in producing coronaviruses in biological cells" with "There is absolutely no evidence that this is the case. A paper presenting this theory (with no proof) has since been retracted.", indicating that there is no evidence to support the claim that 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus.
evidence.rating_text: There is absolutely no evidence that this is the case. A paper presenting this theory (with no proof) has since been retracted.

evidence.title: Experts dismiss claims that 5G wireless technology created the ...
evidence.snippet_en: AFP Fact Check rated the claim "Coronavirus is a result of 5G" as "False", indicating that 5G mobile towers do not spread the coronavirus.

evidence.title: No, 5G 'radiation' has NOT caused the second wave of COVID-19 in ...
evidence.snippet_en: Alt News rated the claim "5G radiation is the cause behind the second wave of coronavirus pandemic in India" as "False", indicating that 5G mobile towers do not spread the coronavirus.

evidence.title: 5G Testing Caused the Second COVID Wave? Viral Post Lacks ...
evidence.snippet_en: The Quint rated the claim "The second wave of COVID-19 was caused due to testing of 5G testing" as "False", indicating that 5G mobile towers do not spread the coronavirus.

evidence.title: Maps do not show link between coronavirus and 5G wireless
evidence.snippet_en: AP News rated the claim "Maps show a correlation between confirmed COVID-19 cases and where 5G wireless service has been installed" as "False", indicating that coronavirus cases did not rise in areas where 5G technology was installed.
